note: Golden traces from tools/reference_sim.py (a transcription of the original's movement code). Hero rows: [room_col, room_row, x, y, state, frame, vx, vy] per tick, x/y = sprite top-left, row 0 = before the first tick. States: 0/1 stand, 2/3 walk, 4/5 jump, 6/7 fall, 8/9 jetpack (even = facing left). Room 99,99 is a test room: solid border (tile 93) and floor rows 10-11. Object rows: [x, y, frame, step, hidden] for 300 ticks from room entry, no activation. Solid objects (lifts/doors) are not modelled.
